purpose: Affected/control live validation of removing the Holo-only scroll magnitude bound; no new API, gate, description variant, full-189 evaluation or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: The completed DOCX retest left Order 104 in GUI navigation loops after Holo scroll(amount=-30) was rejected by its extra [-20,20] schema. That limit is now removed to match the existing signed-integer GUI/native wheel contract; no amount, sign, coordinates, tool description, execution code or task-specific behavior is substituted. Verify the affected task with this one production-schema change.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: A model-selected signed wheel count beyond the former Holo limit reaches the executor unchanged and the next screenshot can reveal later document content. The affected objective remains complete source reading, model-authored answers saved in the user document and original evaluator reward 1, not merely valid scroll dispatch. Control 110 retains exact-path discovery and clipboard success; it controls shared setup/discovery/API handling, not Holo scroll semantics.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task, two workers, 100 global steps, 50 local steps, one same-VM soft restart, 1800 Agent seconds and 30-GiB disk stop. Preserve all results and keep runtime/tests unchanged through worker and supervisor exit. This is the second consecutive affected-104 episode; review and stop the series at its terminal result rather than append an unchanged retry. No full-189 run or promotion is authorized.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Keep the previous DOCX pair immutable: 104 exhausted its Agent deadline after 57 recorded events, while 110 passed in 6. Two isolated description probes returned schema-valid but wrong-direction scrolls and were not adopted. The change is supported by 41 Holo tests and capture-only replay of both preserved -30 calls, not yet by a live changed-contract task result.
repair_hypothesis.focused_verification: Both new signed-wheel regression cases failed under the old constraints; all 41 Holo tests and Ruff passed after removing only minimum/maximum from amount. The entire delegated tool list matches the preserved list after exactly those two constraints are removed. Real grounder/gateway offline replay preserves both raw -30 calls at a capture-only executor without network or GUI execution.
repair_hypothesis.decoding: Retain the split Qwen3.5-4B and Holo3.1-4B endpoints, binary thinking, temperatures 0/0.8, 4096/1024 output caps, Qwen complete-call stop and all current runtime budgets.

selection.method: Order 104 affected Holo scroll-bound failure plus consecutively passing Order 110 local-file discovery/clipboard control, one fresh guest per task in source order.
